introduce: Stand a big step away from the wall, put your hands on the wall and lean on it. \n\nLift your heels as high as you can and then lower them down. Repeat the exercise.
name: LEANING STRETCHER RAISES

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please squeeze your calf muscles when raising your heels up.
Please pause at the top for a few seconds.
Please raise your heels up as high as you can.
Please fully stretch your calves when lowering your heels down.
Inhale deeply as you lower your heels.
Exhale slowly as you raise your heels.
It\'s a great exercise to strengthen your calf muscles.

introduce: Stand with your right hand on the wall. Bend your left leg and grasp your ankle or toes to bring your left calf close to your left thigh. Hold this position.
name: LEFT QUAD STRETCH WITH WALL

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please keep your upper body straight during the exercise.
Your lifted knee should always go straight down.
Focus on your breath and keep it steady and even throughout the stretch.
This exercise can stretch your quadriceps.

introduce: Stand with your left hand on the wall. Bend your right leg and grasp your ankle or toes to bring your right calf close to your right thigh. Hold this position.
name: RIGHT QUAD STRETCH WITH WALL

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please keep your upper body straight during the exercise.
Your lifted knee should always go straight down.
Focus on your breath and keep it steady and even throughout the stretch.
This exercise can stretch your quadriceps.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs lifted and your heels on the wall. 

Pull your toes toward your body, then stretch your ankles and try to use your toes to touch the wall. Repeat the exercise.

Breathe naturally. This exercise stretches your calves and hamstrings.
name: EASY STRETCH LEGS ON THE WALL

tips.text: Please find a wall.
Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your legs straight.
Please keep your lower back always on the floor.
Breathe naturally.
This exercise stretches your calves and hamstrings.

introduce:
Lie on your back with knees bent 90 degrees and feet flat on the wall, hip-width apart. Rest arms by your sides. Lift your hips off the ground.

Lift heels off the wall, then lower them down.

Repeat the exercise.
name: WALL BUTT BRIDGE HOLD & CALF RAISES

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Always keep your core tight.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and away from your ears.
Exhale when lifting your heels, and inhale when lowering them.
You should feel your calves burning.
This exercise works on your glutes, abs, hamstrings and calves.

introduce:
Lie on your back with knees bent 90 degrees and feet flat on the wall, hip-width apart. Rest arms by your sides.

Lift one leg at a time, extending it up the wall, then the other leg.

Return to the starting position and repeat the exercise.
name: WALL LYING WALK

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Keep your hips lifted and core engaged.
Breathe steadily throughout.
It helps exercise your legs.

introduce:
Lie on your back with legs flat on the wall and scoot your hips as close to the wall as possible. Extend your arms to the sides.

Open your legs to your sides as much as you can.

Return and repeat.
name: WALL LYING LEG ABDUCTION

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Inhale when you open your legs, and exhale when you bring them back.
This exercise stretches your inner thighs.

introduce:
Lie on your back with knees bent 90 degrees and feet flat on the wall, hip-width apart. Put your arms straight over the top of your head.

Lift your upper body off the floor, then slowly go back to the starting position.

Repeat the exercise.
name: WALL LONG ARM CRUNCHES

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Focus on using your abdominal muscles.
Keep your neck in a neutral position by avoiding any forward tilting.
Keep your chin slightly tucked towards your chest.
Avoid using your arms to propel your body upwards.
Always keep your lower back on the floor.
Exhale when lifting, and inhale when lowering.
The exercise increases abdominal endurance.

introduce:
Stand facing a wall about a few inches away from it. Place your hands on the wall at chest height and slightly wider than shoulder width.

Bend your left knee to 90 degrees and engage your hips to rotate the leg rightward. Then, extend your left leg to the left side as far as possible while keeping it straight.

Return to the starting position and repeat it.
name: WALL STANDING HIP ABDUCTION LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Engage your core.
Keep your back straight.
Focus on engaging your hips.
Ensure your supporting leg remains firmly planted on the ground.
Exhale as you rotate and extend your left leg to the side.
Inhale as you bring your leg back to the starting position with control.
This workout strengthens the glutes.

introduce:
Stand facing a wall about a few inches away from it. Place your hands on the wall at chest height and slightly wider than shoulder width.

Bend your right knee to 90 degrees and engage your hips to rotate the leg leftward. Then, extend your right leg to the right side as far as possible while keeping it straight.

Return to the starting position and repeat it.
name: WALL STANDING HIP ABDUCTION RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Engage your core.
Keep your back straight.
Focus on engaging your hips.
Ensure your supporting leg remains firmly planted on the ground.
Exhale as you rotate and extend your right leg to the side.
Inhale as you bring your leg back to the starting position with control.
This workout strengthens the glutes.

introduce:
Lie on your back with knees bent 90 degrees and feet flat on the wall, hip-width apart. Rest arms by your sides.

Lift your hips off the floor, forming a straight line from your waist to your knees.

Lower your hips back down to the floor and repeat.
name: WALL BUTT BRIDGE

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Engage your glutes to lift your hips.
Keep your waist, hips, and knees aligned.
Focus on lowering your hips back down to touch the floor.
Exhale when lifting your hips, and inhale when lowering them.
This exercise works on your glutes, abs and hamstrings.
